checks.name: Upload APIs are locked without a valid session; setup token is required and single use
Cross-origin changes and unsafe upload metadata are rejected
Invalid parts and incomplete publication cannot change the current release
A new CLI client resumes a multipart upload and publishes independently verified hashes
Same-name uploads leave the previous version public until all parts are complete
Publication updates the mirror while old immutable downloads remain intact
A concurrent publication is archived and returns a conflict instead of overwriting current
Rollback restores the old file and hashes; stale activation and aborts are safe
Pinned ranges, cache revalidation, checksums, and private paths behave correctly
